derivation.method: Remove provider PBR materials and textures; Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring. Remove wire edges, split edges shared by more than two faces and remove zero-area faces (counts in quality.topology_repairs). Never subdivide to inflate counts.

quality.use: Visual entourage; not certified for fabrication or structural analysis

external_reference_status: Text prompts only: no image was given to any stage. The Ginkgo pass refset_0923 designed its scenes from an owner reference set of 8 images; none of them was submitted to Meshy for these props, and the prompts ask for plain, unbranded objects.
dimension_basis: Heights are the sizes Project Y2K's props_v038 conditioning gave each prop (out/conditioning.json: bag heap 0.72 m, box stack 1.30 m, ivy clump 1.60 m, rubble pile 0.28 m); each mesh was scaled uniformly to that height and its width and depth measured after scaling. Y2K's later ginkgo_props_v061 pass used 0.9 m for the bag heap and 1.0 m for the box stack. Not a physical survey.
reference_review: Reviewed on 2026-11-20: text-to-3D has no input image. The library geometry was checked in its archive preview (640 px) and in untextured front, side, back and three-quarter views (rendered 900 px, viewed at 450 px) and in Project Y2K's textured props_v038 review sheet (1024 px): no lettering, logos or brand marks in the geometry.
rights: Meshy-6 text-to-3D preview and refine on the owner's Meshy account on 2026-09-23 (the same account, by the account ID in the result URLs, as the library's other Meshy batches). The session records the balance (1,023 credits) but not the subscription plan; the plan on that date was not independently audited. Text prompts only. The same props appear in the owner's Ginkgo world packs (GRANDWHIS) and in Project Y2K. Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-20 ("increase the range of models, from the ones i used for my project y2k games, (except for the operatives and bosses)"). Provider textures are not distributed.
